densityHint: Wall density approaches the limit when the layout permits, without exceeding it. Lattice mode prioritises separated wall points and short segments, so actual density may be lower.
markerHint: Switch to Place markers, then click cells inside the region to toggle required open cells. Markers are optional and are not saved.
chooseTileFirst: Select one wall tile before continuing.
missingTileset: The selected layer has no available tileset image.
tileDialogHint: Click one tile. Use the mouse wheel to zoom.
tileDialogHintMac: Click one tile. Pinch or use Command + mouse wheel to zoom; scroll with two fingers to pan.
passableWarning: The selected tile is passable; generated walls will not block movement.
ready: Choose a layer and wall tile.
saved: Region generated and saved. Seed: {0}; wall density within the region: {1:F1}%.
conflict: The map changed. Choose the layer and tile again from the reloaded map.
requiresAvalonia: This plug-in requires the Avalonia editor window.
mapUnavailable: The selected map is no longer available.
noValidLayout: No valid layout could be generated for this map.
invalidTile: The selected tile is no longer valid for this tileset.
invalidMode: The selected layout mode is invalid.
invalidDensity: Wall density must be between 35% and 75%.
latticeTooSmall: Lattice mode requires a region of at least 7 × 7 cells.
roomsTooSmall: Rooms mode requires a region with a short side of at least 7 cells and an area of at least 81 cells.
markerOutOfBounds: At least one marker is outside the map.
noConnectedLayout: The generator could not connect all empty cells without breaking another constraint.
noSafeDensity: The generator could not adjust the wall density within the selected limit without breaking connectivity or edge rules.
noUniformLayout: The generator could not remove all oversized empty areas.
noValidTopology: Could not generate a layout that meets all constraints.
noWallBlocks: The generator could not eliminate adjacent multi-cell wall rows or columns.
latticeStyleFailed: No candidate satisfies the isolated wall points, short wall segments and connected open cells required by lattice mode.
noRoomDoors: No candidate preserved valid room wall rings and one or two single-cell doorways.
noMainTrunk: No candidate produced a connected main trunk through every marker with the required straight segment.
noRoomLayout: No candidate produced enough distributed small rooms, irregular chambers, and alternate corridor routes.
noRoomCount: No candidate could place enough independent small rooms for this map size.
noRoomDistribution: No candidate distributed the rooms across enough distinct map regions.
noRoomShape: No candidate preserved valid small or irregular room interiors.
noRoomCycles: Could not form a corridor loop outside the rooms.
noRoomRoutes: No candidate created enough internal corridor loops and route choices between rooms.
saveFailed: Could not save the map. Map edits and Undo history are unchanged.
unexpectedError: The operation could not be completed. Reload the map and try again.
